name: services/progs/search_history_affect
description:
Add a programme to search history.

This method aims at improving user experience while searching. Call this method once your user visits programme's page, or when he/she selects a programme while searching for prorgammes, etc.

Given programme will be added to search history. Items saved in search history may appear more frequently in search results.
brief_description: Add a programme to search history.

arguments.name: programme_id
arguments.description: The ID of the programme you want saved to the search history.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
